concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement expressly sets 1 February 2027 as the Effective Date; the parties signed earlier, on 29 January 2027, with effectiveness deferred.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by talus ventures ab in fjordsignal as’s marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by Talus Ventures AB in FjordSignal AS’s marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch.
justifications: The agreement identifies this as the sole Permitted Purpose and specifies the investment type, business, and project name.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: The disclosure window ordinarily ends on 31 January 2028, but the effective termination notice closes it on 30 November 2027. The earlier return request does not itself terminate the window.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The agreement expressly designates the courts of Oslo as the parties’ contractual forum.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is identified as registered in Norway and as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is identified as registered in Sweden and as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: At the snapshot, LUMEN’s non-public combination remains protected despite its public components, SHORE’s prior module does not exclude the complete package, and CEDAR’s authorised public release occurs later. MICA is excluded by proven independent development, BASALT’s breach-caused posting does not establish the public-information exclusion, and ORACLE’s provisional protection had ended before the snapshot without yet being restored by acceptance.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: The five Business Days after the 25 March oral disclosure are 30 March, 31 March, 1 April, 2 April, and 5 April, after applying the stated excluded dates and weekends.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection was not continuous. oracle was provisionally protected from its oral disclosure on 25 march 2027 until the five-business-day confirmation deadline at 17:00 utc on 5 april. although confirmation was sent on 5 april at 16:58, it was delivered to the designated mailbox on 6 april at 09:05, so it was late: delivery, not sending, controls. the provisional protection therefore ended at the deadline, leaving a gap until the recipient’s written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00, when protection resumed prospectively without covering the gap. as ordinary information, it remains protected until the later applicable duration date: 1 february 2030, rather than 25 march 2029.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection was not continuous. ORACLE was provisionally protected from its oral disclosure on 25 March 2027 until the five-Business-Day confirmation deadline at 17:00 UTC on 5 April. Although confirmation was sent on 5 April at 16:58, it was delivered to the designated mailbox on 6 April at 09:05, so it was late: delivery, not sending, controls. The provisional protection therefore ended at the deadline, leaving a gap until the Recipient’s written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00, when protection resumed prospectively without covering the gap. As ordinary information, it remains protected until the later applicable duration date: 1 February 2030, rather than 25 March 2029.
justifications: The oral disclosure was expressly identified as confidential, but confirmation arrived after the five-Business-Day deadline because delivery occurred after the deadline despite timely sending. The late confirmation did not itself restore protection; written acceptance did so prospectively, and the ordinary-information duration extends to the later of the two stated dates.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: Prior possession is established only for the smaller module incorporated into SHORE; the new branching map, thresholds, and complete package were not shown to have been previously possessed. Knowing one component does not exclude the entire package.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The entire schedule was independently and lawfully released to the unrestricted public on this date, establishing the public-information exclusion for the complete schedule and ending its protection.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin meets the employee, undertaking, security-check, and clean-room requirements. Marek is an employee of an Affiliate because the Recipient controls 52% of its votes at the snapshot, and his required approvals were effective by then; Oskar qualifies as a professional adviser through his enforceable duty of confidence and has completed the required security check and clean-room approval.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: At the access snapshot, 48% of votes are held directly and a disjoint 4% is covered by a presently effective irrevocable proxy, totaling 52% countable voting power.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Talus Research qualifies as an Affiliate because the Recipient controls 52% of its votes on that date. Marek's undertaking and security check were already effective, and his named clean-room approval became effective on 14 September, completing the access requirements.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Because notice was initially prohibited, the deadline was the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition was lifted and the production time. Six hours after the prohibition was lifted at 11:20 on 5 July 2027 was 17:20 that day, earlier than production on 6 July.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: Because notice was initially prohibited, the deadline was the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition was lifted (17:20 on July 5) and the production time. The compelled-notice exception uses actual arrival, so arrival at 17:55 was 35 minutes late.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires all of P1 and only non-privileged subsection P3A. P2 and P4 were withdrawn, and P3B was identified as privileged and outside the production duty.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November, earlier than the termination date, so the ten-Business-Day period starts with the next eligible day. Excluding the specified holidays and weekends, the tenth Business Day is 8 December; restoring WORK-1 does not restart the deadline, and no binding preservation order covers it.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The earlier return request triggered the retention period on 22 November 2027. The 45-calendar-day limit falls after the scheduled 30 December overwrite, and restoring a copy does not restart either clock.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: The segregated counsel-held archive qualifies for the archival exception, and the immutable backup remains within its permitted retention period at the snapshot. HOLD-1 is covered by a binding preservation order still in force; WORK-1 is an overdue active copy, and NOTE-1 is not covered by an exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: NOTE-1 contains deliberately recorded parameter values and reconstruction notes, which are excluded from residual-knowledge permission. Training a model on Confidential Information or derivatives is prohibited without a separate signed licence, and no such licence applies.
